'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Chris Gogolen LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Gogolen]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Communing (Virtual Block 7)|VB7-L-communing-pre.gif|label=Communing}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
